Update: September PPI: energy drove the goods surge as services rose

The BLS release of 15 October 2026 showed a 1.3% September headline rise and a 0.5% increase excluding foods, energy and trade services.

What to watch: A lasting inflation signal from the September 2026 release would require repeated gains outside energy; weaker underlying readings would challenge it.

Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/september-ppi-energy-drove-the-goods

Retrospective analysis, written on 5 November 2026 (GMT+7) Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.
